mapper.select: SELECT m.*, e1.name as evaluateeName, d1.name as evaluateeDeptName, e2.name as evaluatorName, d2.name as evaluatorDeptName FROM EVALUATOR_MAPPING m JOIN EMPLOYEE e1 ON m.evaluatee_id = e1.id LEFT JOIN DEPARTMENT d1 ON e1.department_id = d1.id JOIN EMPLOYEE e2 ON m.evaluator_id = e2.id LEFT JOIN DEPARTMENT d2 ON e2.department_id = d2.id ORDER BY m.id DESC

SELECT m.*, e1.name as evaluateeName, d1.name as evaluateeDeptName, e2.name as evaluatorName, d2.name as evaluatorDeptName FROM EVALUATOR_MAPPING m JOIN EMPLOYEE e1 ON m.evaluatee_id = e1.id LEFT JOIN DEPARTMENT d1 ON e1.department_id = d1.id JOIN EMPLOYEE e2 ON m.evaluator_id = e2.id LEFT JOIN DEPARTMENT d2 ON e2.department_id = d2.id WHERE m.id = #{id}
